selected_option.choice_text: Sit down right next to Mia anyway

sequence.text: Joey was excited to play, so he sat close to Mia without thinking about it.
Mia doesn't look happy and feels uncomfortable.
Mia still wanted a little more space, but Joey was busy building and didn't notice.
Joey sees a perfect piece for his castle in Mia's blocks.
Mia was still quietly building, sitting a little farther away from Joey now.

sequence.title: Joey's Decision
sequence.decision_prompt: Mia moved a little farther away. What should Joey do now?
